The current state of the system is a natural result of the chronological execution (fold/reduce) of all these events added from the past to the present. Şöyle düşünün: Bir priz standardı gibidi: Think of it this way: It's like a plug standard; It allows different data sources to be easily connected to artificial intelligence, just as every device works with the same plug.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir profesörün yıllarca b: Think of it this way: It is like a professor summarizing the knowledge he has accumulated over the years to a student in a short and concise way.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir ressamın birinin yüzü: Think of it this way: Just as a painter can perfectly draw someone's face just by looking at a few photos, AI can replicate the timbre of a voice.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir restoranda garson, si: Think of it this way: In a restaurant, the waiter acts as an API, relaying your order to the kitchen and bringing the food to you.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir restoranın ünlü tatlı: Think of it this way: Imagine that a restaurant keeps the recipe for its famous dessert hidden in the safe; Closed source software is exactly that. Customers cannot know the additives in it or improve the recipe. Open source is like a chef publishing his recipe, all measurements and cooking techniques in an open gastronomy encyclopedia. Cooks all over the world examine this recipe, add local spices, fill in the gaps and create new flavours. The recipe is in the public domain; Anyone who wishes can make it at home, or serve it in its improved form in a restaurant.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir stajyere işi öğretmek: Think of it this way: It's like teaching an intern the job. The intern prepares a report, and you train him by saying 'this part is very good, but change that tone'. Over time, the intern learns what you like.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir uçağın tüm parçaların: Think of it this way: It is like reflecting all parts of an airplane in a digital environment and simulating its digital copy with the same data while the real airplane is in the air.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir yabancı dili hiç bilm: Think of it this way: It's like giving someone who doesn't know a foreign language the rules and dictionary of that language, and helping him or her to converse fluently with you over time.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir yazarın her gün aynı: Think of it this way: It's like the difference between a writer writing in the same style every day (low temperature) and trying different styles every day (high temperature).
Şöyle düşünün: Bir yemeğin tarifini gizl: Think of it this way: Instead of keeping the recipe for a dish secret, it's like publishing it in a public cookbook and allowing everyone to improve that recipe and make it more delicious.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir çocuğa sadece iki tan: Think of it this way: It's like teaching a child what an apple is by just showing him two apples.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir çocuğun dünyayı gözle: Think of it this way: Just as a child learns by observing the world, a computer develops rules for itself by examining huge piles of data.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir çocuğun oyuncağını ye: Think of it this way: Just as a child knows that his toy will fall when he puts it on the ground, artificial intelligence learns the basic functioning of the physical world.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir öğrencinin sınavda bi: Think of it this way: It's like a student answering a question he doesn't know in an exam by making up a completely imaginary story as if he were very sure.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir öğrencinin sınavda sa: Think of it this way: It is like a student taking an open book with him and writing answers by looking at the relevant page during the exam, instead of relying only on his memorization.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir şefin gizli tarifini: Think of it this way: It's like a chef not only writing down his secret recipe on paper, but also allowing anyone to follow all the cooking steps and tips of that dish.
Şöyle düşünün: Bir şefin mutfaktaki tüm: Think of it this way: Just as a chef manages all the cooks in the kitchen and ensures that the food comes out on time, artificial intelligence manages the flow of tasks.
Şöyle düşünün: Danışma masasındaki memur: Think of it this way: Imagine the difference between the clerk at the information desk and the operations director. Ask the officer (traditional LLM) 'How do I buy a Paris ticket?' If you ask, he explains the steps and stays silent; does not take action. You say to the operations director (Agentic AI) 'Buy me the most suitable ticket for tomorrow'. The director connects to flight sites via API, compares prices, makes the reservation and downloads the ticket to your phone. Agentic AI is the transformation from a consultant who gives advice to an executive assistant who gets the job done.
Şöyle düşünün: Eski yöntemler bir cümley: Think of it this way: The old methods were like a student reading a sentence by looking at individual words. Transformer, on the other hand, is like a genius who focuses on the entire page at a glance and instantly sees which words complement each other.
Şöyle düşünün: Evinizin kapısındaki kili: Think of it this way: It's like a thief noticing the manufacturing defect in the lock on the door of your house before you do, and being able to easily open that door without you even knowing about it.
Şöyle düşünün: Farklı ülkelerden gelen v: Consider this: Imagine hundreds of civil engineers coming from different countries who want to build a shared architectural masterpiece. If each engineer uses their own country's unit of measurement (inch, centimeter, arshyn) and prefers their own drawing symbols, the columns will not align and the building will collapse. Sun Code Conventions is the common metric system and architectural alphabet standard of the Java world. Regardless of the country or company they come from, another engineer who opens a class file written by a Java engineer understands at a glance where the columns and beams (classes and methods) are placed.
Şöyle düşünün: Geleneksel veritabanı bir: Think of it this way: A traditional database is like an alphabetical catalog in a library. Vector database is like a concept map in a person's mind; It works like when you think of an idea, all of your memories associated with it come to your mind at the same time.
Şöyle düşünün: Genel tıp eğitimi almış b: Think of it this way: It is like a doctor who has received general medicine training and becomes a surgeon or cardiologist after receiving specialized training for a certain period of time.
Şöyle düşünün: Gürültülü bir kokteyl par: Think of it this way: Imagine listening to the person you're talking to at a noisy cocktail party. The old RNN architecture records all sounds equally and in order; As the conversation gets longer, the voices blend together and the main theme disappears. The human brain and the Transformer hear the hum in the room at the same time, but only pay attention to the voice of the person it is talking to and the critical words. Transformer puts all the words in the sentence on the table at the same time and calculates the semantic connection between the words in seconds.
Şöyle düşünün: Her şeyi bilen bir ansikl: Think of it this way: Instead of an all-knowing encyclopedia, it's more like a practical handbook you carry in your bag and can find everything you need quickly.
Şöyle düşünün: Hiç görmediğiniz bir yaba: Think of it this way: It's like trying to guess the word in a foreign language you've never seen before, just from the wording of the sentence.
Şöyle düşünün: Kirada oturmak yerine ken: Think of it this way: It's like building your own house and taking on all the renovation and management work yourself, instead of living on rent.
Şöyle düşünün: Milyarlarca kitabı okumuş: Think of it this way: He is like a linguist who has read billions of books and solved the structure of all languages and has the largest library in the world.
Şöyle düşünün: Milyonlarca kitabın yalnı: Think of it this way: A library where millions of books are sorted solely by alphabetical author name is a classic SQL database. If you say, 'Bring me novels that describe the feeling of loneliness, have autumn sadness, and are Dostoyevsky-style', the classic catalog will be locked because these words may not appear on the covers. A vector database is like placing books in a huge galaxy. Sad books are collected in a certain cluster of stars, science fiction adventures are located in another branch. When you come up with a feeling, the system finds the nearest neighboring stars in the galaxy in milliseconds.
Şöyle düşünün: Milyonlarca klasik müzik: Think of it this way: Imagine a talented pianist who has listened to millions of classical music compositions and jazz recordings. When you play three notes on the keyboard, it instantly senses which harmony should follow the sounds and completes the melody with grace. LLM is exactly that language composer. Not the abstract meanings in his mind; It carries a mathematical harmony that calculates which expression is most likely to come after which word. Once you start the sentence, it continues with possibilities filtered through the collective library of humanity.
Şöyle düşünün: Sadece bir tornavida kull: Think of it this way: Instead of just using a screwdriver, it's like setting up a full workshop by combining a drill, saw, and measuring device.
Şöyle düşünün: Sadece okuyarak öğrenen b: Think of it this way: Rather than someone who only learns by reading, he is like a person who perceives the world by both reading, watching and listening.
Şöyle düşünün: Sadece resimlere bakan bi: Think of it this way: He is not an art critic who just looks at pictures, but a painter who takes a brush and paints a new picture.
Şöyle düşünün: Sadece satranç oynayan bi: Think of it this way: Instead of a computer program that only plays chess, imagine an intelligence that can both cook and write poetry.
Şöyle düşünün: Sadece tarif veren bir ki: Think of it like this: It is not just a book that gives recipes, it is like an assistant chef who goes into the kitchen and cooks the food according to the recipe, and if there are missing ingredients, he goes to the market and buys them.
Şöyle düşünün: Trafik kurallarının bulun: Think of it this way: imagine a highway with no traffic rules, where every driver changes lanes as they please; on such a road, accidents are inevitable. A standard style guide is like the lane markings and traffic lights of that highway. When thousands of engineers work on the same codebase, as long as the rules are followed, no one crashes into anyone else. A developer joining a new project feels right at home because the rhythm and structure of the code are woven with universal rules.
Şöyle düşünün: Tıp fakültesindeki iki sı: Think of it this way: Imagine two exam scenarios in medical school. In the closed book exam, the student answers thousands of pages of literature from memory; Where he cannot remember, he may make up a false diagnosis that seems reasonable but could be fatal (LLM hallucination). In the open book exam, the student opens the most current medical encyclopedia in the library, reads the fresh research, and responds by citing verified data. RAG architecture transforms AI from rote learning to an open-book researcher with a huge library on his desk.
Şöyle düşünün: Tıp fakültesini dereceyle: Think of it this way: Imagine a young physician who graduated from medical school with honors. This physician has complete knowledge of basic biology, human anatomy, pharmacology and general medical knowledge; In other words, he has successfully completed his pre-training. However, you cannot expect this doctor to directly undergo heart transplant surgery. A physician does not need to go to medical school from scratch to become a surgeon; instead, he specializes exclusively in a cardiac surgery clinic for several years. Fine-Tuning is exactly this specialization; It equips a model with basic language knowledge with the terminology and reflexes of a specific branch.
Şöyle düşünün: Çok yüksek çözünürlüklü b: Think of it this way: It's like compressing a very high-resolution photo to reduce the file size without noticeably degrading the image quality. You gain speed by sacrificing some details.
Şöyle düşünün: İnsan beyni güçlü bir işl: Think of it this way: The human brain is a powerful processor (CPU) but has a limited working memory (RAM). Trying to keep ideas, important sentences from articles, or software solutions in mind is like the processor wasting its power on tabs left open in the background. Setting up a PKM system is like placing an external hard drive next to your mind that never forgets. When you transfer information there, your brain is freed from the storage burden; it focuses on synthesizing, making connections, and creating.
Şöyle düşünün: İnternet gerektiren bir k: Think of it this way: Instead of going to a library that requires internet, it's like having all the books in your own library at home.
Şöyle düşünün: İşlerini sürekli uzaktaki: Think of it this way: A field engineer, who carries out his work by constantly calling the remote head office and consulting, cannot make any decisions and his work stops completely when the phone network goes down. On the other hand, the offline-first approach is just like the engineer carrying all the plans, instructions, technical library and calculation tools of the project in a durable bag next to him. The engineer takes his notes, draws his projects and completes his calculations, even in the most isolated valley where there is no internet or base station on the mountain top. At the first connection with the head office, it synchronizes the data of both parties by transmitting only the new records received in the field to the head office. The offline approach makes the user the real owner of his hardware, rather than relying on a remote server signal.
